title: Org3
tagline: A ENS subdomain-based organization management tool with better user eperience and security

prizes.placement: 🕸 The Graph — 🥇 Best Use of Subgraph
prizes.title: The Graph

description:
# Summary
This project is an ENS subdomain-based access control web3 organization management tool that has several advantages over the state-of-the-art tokengated access control.
# Advantages and innovation
1. Intuitive organization tree structure
2. Decouple wallet address, admin control & access control - safe!
3. Inexpensive, more accessible - no need to make and distributed tokens/NFT!
# Product Features
1. Automated generate visualization of one's ENS's subdomains tree.
2. Interactive smart contract interaction of organization tree update.
3. File access control based on subdomain namespace.
how_its_made: This project uses ENS's smart contract and subdomain technology, the graph's protocol for fast querying and updating of ENS' domains/subdomains, IPFS for saving encrypted files, and finally lit protocol for encryption/decryption. We have our own smart contract too to keep a registry of the file table.
